research_notes: Initial research 2026-10-01: official occupation list, employer annual reviews, employer statement and first-person interview reviewed. Searches for pharmacy outlet, individual hours, public professional profile and school governance did not resolve payroll/full-time status. Generic biography assertions of part-time work lack reliable corroboration and were not adopted.

Follow-up: TerryWhite outlet/legal entity, hours and leave; exact school-program employment versus participation/volunteering and overlapping work; UWU start conflict; pre-2018 work/study history; Australian Islamic College 2022 board lead, appointment/end/remuneration. Official exact dates alone are insufficient for full-time years.

Recovered source errors: American Rhetoric first-speech mirror403; ERCWA2021–22 PDF400 Timeout fetching, indexed primary passage used; school-board reference click could not resolve. These are individual source gaps, not job-wide blockers.
Family members’ occupations are not Payman’s employment. Pharmacy assistant wording is not upgraded to pharmacist. No duration is summed across overlapping intervals.

Follow-up 2026-10-02: UWA MSA past-president table, September 2022 first-person interview, Women for Election recording biography and November 2022 AMUST interview. Identified student association and police advisory roles, tutoring and undergraduate fields; preserved pay/date uncertainties.

School-board original and archival links from Wikipedia returned Unable to resolve click call due to invalid arguments; primary board appointment remains unverified. Secondary repeats do not independently establish term/pay. Seek AIC annual report or appointment register in later pass.

Pharmacy searches found no reliable full-time proof or outlet. SignalHire displayed conflicting month dates, federal department label and other roles; these are discovery leads only and were not substituted for exact official dates. Unsourced biography claims of part-time work still unverified. Tutoring payroll/client and charity-base role boundaries need first-person or organisation records.

Follow-up 2026-10-03: Australian Islamic College's own June 2022 post verifies Payman as a board member at that observation. The current board page no longer lists her and states governance/remuneration rules, but no appointment or departure record was found. Retain board service as excluded nonprofit governance; future follow-up needs a historical annual report or archived board register for term dates.

Follow-up2026-10-04: Follow-up targets: pharmacy outlet/payroll/hours, tutoring pay, school board historical annual reports and school-program coordination. Official occupation extract still gives exact dates but no hours/outlet; unattributed biography aggregators repeat part-time wording without primary support and are not adopted. Authoritative-site searches of AIC/ERCWA and Terry White part-time terms returned no new attributable record. Another pharmacist’s Cumberland Park post concerns an award presented by Payman, not her workplace. Staff job ads with part-time labels concern senator employees, not Payman. Retain 2019–2020 pharmacy/electorate overlap and school governance as documented; priority remains employer/franchise personnel evidence, a historical AIC register and DCLI contract/payment terms.
